text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We started our meeting, but she seemed 
completely distracted, so I asked if 
something was wrong...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... My head and body both feel so 
heavy... I feel like it's been this way 
all the time lately~

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I made mistake after mistake on today's 
quiz again... Stuff like writing the 
answers on the wrong lines~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could it be fatigue from her recent races? 
I'll review her schedule once more.
